If 5 divided the integer n, the remainder is 2. What will be remainder if 7n is divided by 5?
questions.solution:
Let n = 7, then condition satisfied.

Hence, 7n = 7 × 7 = 49

Now, 49 ÷ 5, then remainder is 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

Let the number be 5x.

Then, The integer n = 5x + 2

Take x = 1 

Then, n = 7

The value of 7n = 49

49 divided by 5 leaves the remainder 4

**∴ 4 is the remainder if 7n is divided by 5.**

questions.question: If x, y, z are three numbers such that x + y = 13, y + z = 15 and z + x = 16, then the value of frac{{xy + xz}}{{xyz}} is:
questions.solution:
**Given: **

x + y = 13, y + z = 15 and z + x = 16

**Calculation:**

Adding all given equations, we get

2(x + y + z) = 44

⇒ x + y + z = 22

Hence, x = 22 – 15 = 7

y = 22 – 16 = 6

and, z = 22 – 13 = 9

Now,

(xy + xz)/xyz

⇒ (y + z)/yz

⇒ 15/(6 × 9)

⇒ 5/18

questions.question: In a circle, chords PQ and TS are produced to meet at R. if RQ = 14.4 cm, PQ = 11.2 cm, and SR = 12.8 cm, then the length of chord TS is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/688df3789646681106f997b46031179f8771122d69346cdac7e8028537e44e7a.png] 

RP = RQ + PQ = 14.4 + 11.2 = 25.6

As we know,

RP × RQ = RT × RS

⇒ 25.6 × 14.4 = RT × 12.8

⇒ RT = 28.8 cm

Now, TS = RT – RS = 28.8 – 12.8 = **16 cm.**

questions.question: A, B and C can individually complete a task in 24 days, 16 days and 32 days respectively. If A and C start the work and worked for 6 days and left, then the number of days required by B to complete the remaining task, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afdfae1fcede5b6585a3c0adf80641fc248e14db6c71f382ad49132ca10cfc59.png] 

Total work = 96 units (LCM of 24, 16 and 32)

Hence, efficiency of A = 4 units, B = 6 units and C = 3 units

Work done by A and C in 6 days = (4 + 3) × 6 = 42 units

Remaining work = 96 – 42 = 54 units

Remaining work, B complete in = 54/6 = 9 days

questions.question: If a² + b² – c² = 0, then the value of frac{{2( {{a⁶} + {b⁶} - {c⁶}} )}}{{3{a²}{b²}{c²}}} is:

questions.question: Amit travelled a distance of 50 km in 9 hours. He travelled partly on foot at 5 km/h and partly by bicycle at 10 km/h. The distance travelled on the bicycle is:
questions.solution:
Average speed = 50/9 km/hr

Using allegation method

10 km/hr 5 km/hr

50/9 km/hr

5/9 40/9

Time ratio to cover distance by bicycle to that of foot = 5/9 : 40/9 = 1 : 8

Now, (1 + 8) units = 9 hours

⇒ 1 unit = 1 hour

Hence, time taken by bicycle = 1 hour

Distance covered by bicycle = 10 × 1 = 10 km

questions.question: The average of 4 terms is 30 and the 1st term is 1/3 of the sum of the remaining terms. What is the first term?
questions.solution:
Let the sum of last three terms be 3x.

According to the Question, the first term will be:

= 3x × 1/3 = x

Average of 4 terms is given as 30, i.e.

(Sum of 4 terms)/4 = 30

Sum of 4 terms = 120

From the above concluded data, we can write:

x + 3x = 120

4x = 120

x = 120/4

**x = 30**

First term is 30.

questions.question: When 2 is subtracted from each of the given n numbers, then the sum of the numbers so obtained is 102. When 5 is subtracted from each of them, then the sum of the numbers so obtained is 12. What is the average of the given n numbers?
questions.solution:
**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Let the sum of n numbers be x, then

According to the question

x – 2n = 102 …(1)

x – 5n = 12 …(2)

Subtract equation (1) from equation (2)

3n = 90

⇒ n = 30

From equation (1)

x – 60 = 102

⇒ x = 102 + 60 = 162

**∴ Average of first n numbers = 162/30 = 5.4**

questions.question: The value of (cosec A + cot A + 1) (cosec A – cot A +1) – 2cosec A is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(cosecA + cotA + 1)(cosecA – cotA +1) – 2cosecA

**Calculation:**

(cosecA + cotA + 1)(cosecA– cotA +1) – 2cosecA

⇒ (cosecA + 1 + cotA)(cosecA + 1 – cotA) – 2cosecA

⇒ [(cosecA + 1)2 – cot2A] – 2 cosecA

⇒ cosec2A + 1 + 2cosecA – cot2A – 2cosecA

⇒ cosec2A – cot2A + 1

⇒ 1 + 1 = 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

(cosecA + cotA + 1)(cosecA – cotA +1) – 2cosecA

Put A = 90°

(cosec90 + cot90 + 1)(cosec90 – cot90 +1) – 2cosec90

⇒ (1 + 0 + 1) (1 – 0 + 1) – 2

⇒ 2 × 2 – 2

⇒ 4 – 2 = 2

questions.question: A train X travelling at 60 km/h overtakes another train Y, 225 m long, and completely passes it in 72 seconds. If the trains had been going in opposite directions, they would have passed each other in 18 seconds. The length (in m) of X and the speed (in km/h) of Y are, respectively:
questions.solution:
Let the length of the train X be l m and speed of train Y be x km/hr

As we know,

Time = Distance/speed

72 = frac{{225 + l}}{{( {60 - x} )(5)/({18)}}} …1)

18 = frac{{225 + l}}{{( {60 + x} )(5)/({18)}}} …2)

Multiply by 4 in equation (2)

72 = frac{{4( {225 + l} )}}{{( {60 + x} )(5)/({18)}}} …3)

From equation (1) and equation (3)

frac{{4( {225 + l} )}}{{( {60 + x} )(5)/({18)}}} = frac{{225 + l}}{{( {60 - x} )(5)/({18)}}}

⇒ 4 (60 – x) = (60 + x)

⇒ 240 – 4x = 60 + x

⇒ 4x + x = 240 – 60

⇒ 5x = 180

⇒ x = 36

∴ Speed of train Y is 36 km/hr

From equation (1)

72 = frac{{225 + l}}{{( {60 - 36} )(5)/({18)}}}

⇒ 72 × 24 × 5/18 = 225 + l

⇒ 480 = 225 + l

⇒ l = 480 – 225

⇒ l = 255 m

∴ Length of train X is 255 m

questions.question: A wheel covers a distance of 1,100 cm in one round. The diameter of the wheel is:
questions.solution:
Distance covered by 1 round = perimeter of the circle

2πr = 1100

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × r = 1100

⇒ r = 1100 × 7/22 × 1/2

⇒ r = 175 cm

∴ Diameter of the wheel = 2 × 175 = 350 cm

questions.question: Find the height of a cuboid whose volume is 330 cm³ and the base area is 15 cm².
questions.solution:
As we know,

Volume of cuboid = Area of Base × Height

⇒ 15 × h = 330

⇒ h = 330/15

⇒ h = 22 cm

So, height of the cuboid is 22 cm.

questions.question: In which month does Company II have a contribution of approximately 20% in the total fertilizer production by it?
questions.solution:
Total production of company II during the months = 180 + 179 + 160 + 167 + 150 = 836

Now, 20% of 836 = 836 × 1/5 = 167.2

So, in April month, company II have a contribution approximately 20% in the total fertilizer production.
